figures.caption: Fig. 1 Schematic representation of the psycho–neural bridge based on connectome harmonics {ξλ(s)}, within which neural activity patterns are described, in the framework of neural field theory, from two complementary perspectives: bottom-up processing and reversed top-down processing. The blurred boundaries of mental images reflect uncertainty in its embedding within the mental representation of environmental space.

Fig. 2 Characteristics of the Ψ-dynamics underlying the proposed mechanics of the change-of-mind phenomenon, obtained from the numerical solution of Eq. (35). Panel I shows the potential Ω(x), which reflects the properties of the choice options Ωi (i = 1, 2). Panel II presents the time dependence of the quantities {Pi(t)} (as well as their sum P12(t)), specified by Exp. (37) and interpreted as the probabilities of choosing the options {Ωi}. Panels III and IV illustrate the evolution of the cloudfunction magnitude |Ψ(x, t)|2: Panel III displays its spatial distribution at several time points, while Panel IV shows its time dependence at the points x1 and x2, corresponding to the local maxima of Ω(x). The numerical simulations were performed with the following parameter values: x1 = 10, x2 = 35, A1 = 9.5, A2 = 7, σ1 = 1, σ2 = 5 (parameters of Ω(x), see Exp. (33)), and cω = 3, cη = 6 (parameters of the Hamiltonian Ĥ, see Exp. (34)).
